producer_report.summary: The final CI job (id `ci`) now has the display name `fmt, clippy, tests`, the check name branch protection requires. The only change in ci.yml is that name line. A new test in xtask/tests/ci_shards.rs fails unless exactly one job carries that name, it is the `ci` job, and it needs gate, fmt, clippy and test. The CHANGELOG amends the 0rz6 entry and adds a Fixed entry citing PR #314's HTTP 405. ci-routing.md section 4.2 is updated to match. Root cause: 0rz6 gave the final job the display name `ci`, so the required check was never reported. Branch protection is not edited. The new test checks ci.yml only; whether the check run appears under the new name on PR #314's head is not visible from the repository.

checks_run.note: Run before the one-line clippy fix: 40 unit tests, 19 ci_shards (including the new test and the drop-`if: always()`/drop-a-need mutation test), 10 fingerprint, 12 policy, 5 site_page, 30 spec and 6 walltime tests passed.
The first run flagged clippy::manual_contains in the new helper. I fixed it and the rerun is clean.
Rerun after the clippy fix: 19 ci_shards and 12 policy tests passed, including the boundary-words scan.
Exactly one changed line: `name: ci` became `name: fmt, clippy, tests` on the `ci` job.

criteria_check.criterion: In .github/workflows/ci.yml the job with id `ci` (needs gate, fmt, clippy, test; `if: always()`; same steps) has the line `    name: fmt, clippy, tests`, and Grep finds no other job with that name.
criteria_check.evidence: git diff shows line 401 changed to `    name: fmt, clippy, tests` on job `ci`, with needs, `if: always()` and steps unchanged. The new test counts exactly one job with that name, and it passes when run with the ci_shards tests.

criteria_check.criterion: xtask/tests/ci_shards.rs contains a test that parses ci.yml and asserts that exactly one job is named `fmt, clippy, tests` and that its `needs` lists every check job (gate, fmt, clippy, test); it would fail on the previous file, where the final job is named `ci`. The old `name: ci` assertion in check_jobs is replaced.
criteria_check.evidence: Added check_required_name and the test workflow_required_check_name_is_on_exactly_one_job_that_needs_every_check. It parses ci.yml with jobs(), and its mutation cases are name reverted to `ci`, the name copied onto `pass`, and `fmt` dropped from needs. All three mutations are rejected. On the old file no job has the name, so the helper returns Err (count 0). check_jobs now calls check_required_name(text)? in place of the `name: ci` line check.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p xtask`: the new test and all existing ci_shards and policy tests pass, including the mutation tests that drop `if: always()` or a need.
criteria_check.evidence: cargo test -p xtask passed in full, and the ci_shards and policy targets passed again after the clippy fix. workflow_jobs_reject_a_missing_gate_condition_need_or_timeout is among the passing tests.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --check`; both are clean.
criteria_check.evidence: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings finished clean after fixing one manual_contains warning. cargo fmt --all --check printed nothing and exited 0.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md amends the 0rz6 entry: the final job is named `fmt, clippy, tests` (job id `ci`), branch protection needs no change, and the EARLY_RUN_JOB known effect is removed or marked resolved. A new entry notes the rename and the reason (PR #314 405 error).
criteria_check.evidence: The 0rz6 Added entry now says the final job has id `ci` and the name `fmt, clippy, tests`, and that branch protection needs no change. Known effect (1) is marked resolved for the name and keeps the marker-timing caveat. A new Fixed entry gives the cause (the `ci` display name) and PR #314's HTTP 405.

criteria_check.criterion: The diff changes the display name only: job id, needs, `if: always()`, steps and every other job in ci.yml are unchanged (check with git diff).
criteria_check.evidence: git diff -- .github/workflows/ci.yml shows a single changed line, the name line of the `ci` job.

open_issues: Whether PR #314 can merge depends on branch protection settings and on the check run appearing under the new name on the PR head. The repository cannot show either.
Known caveat kept in CHANGELOG and ci-routing.md: the `ci` job can finish before `pass` saves the marker, so a landing run can still miss the cached pass. The rename does not change this.
mistakes: My first version of the helper used `lines.iter().any(|l| *l == line)`, which clippy rejected with manual_contains. I fixed it and re-ran clippy, fmt and the tests.
learnings: The `jobs()` parser in xtask/tests/ci_shards.rs drops comment lines and stops at the next top-level key, so the workflow-level `name: ci` at the top of ci.yml is not counted as a job name.
Clippy 1.97 flags `lines.iter().any(|l| *l == x)` as manual_contains in test targets, so it must be `lines.contains(&x)`.
EARLY_RUN_JOB in crates/athena-core/src/gh/early.rs already names `fmt, clippy, tests`, so no change was needed there.
